guest_slot_values_valid.name: guest_slot_values_valid
guest_slot_values_valid.value: "guest_slots"."display_order" >= 0 AND ("guest_slots"."assigned_name" IS NULL OR char_length(btrim("guest_slots"."assigned_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120)

media_backup_values_valid.name: media_backup_values_valid
media_backup_values_valid.value: char_length(btrim("media_backups"."provider")) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND char_length(btrim("media_backups"."object_prefix")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "media_backups"."attempts" >= 0

media_dimensions_together.name: media_dimensions_together
media_dimensions_together.value: ("media_objects"."width" IS NULL AND "media_objects"."height" IS NULL) OR ("media_objects"."width" > 0 AND "media_objects"."height" > 0)

media_customer_ownership.name: media_customer_ownership
media_customer_ownership.value: "media_objects"."usage" = 'CATALOG_ARTWORK' OR ("media_objects"."owner_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_objects"."job_order_id" IS NOT NULL)

notification_delivery_values_valid.name: notification_delivery_values_valid
notification_delivery_values_valid.value: char_length(btrim("notification_deliveries"."kind")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND char_length(btrim("notification_deliveries"."recipient")) BETWEEN 3 AND 320 AND "notification_deliveries"."attempts" >= 0

payment_values_valid.name: payment_values_valid
payment_values_valid.value: "payment_entries"."amount_minor" <> 0 AND "payment_entries"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND char_length(btrim("payment_entries"."method")) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND ("payment_entries"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("payment_entries"."note") <= 500)

rsvp_values_valid.name: rsvp_values_valid
rsvp_values_valid.value: "rsvps"."revision" > 0 AND "rsvps"."submitted_invitation_version" > 0 AND ("rsvps"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("rsvps"."note") <= 500)
